messages:
alert-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — NLB euc2b facing elevated 5xx rate across inbound worker-targets. 5xx rate 5.8% in last 5m, spike start 2026-03-15 18:23 UTC. alerts: nlb-euc2b-5xx > 5% threshold

ops-oncall: paging oncall @siva - please ack and triage. Any customer impact? 

siva: acked. I'm on it. collecting quick metrics now. tagging @laura for ingress routing.

samir: seeing connection resets in Envoy logs for pods behind target-group tg-wg-01. example log snippet:
```
[envoy] [upstream] handshake failed: connection reset by peer, client_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate
```

laura: can we confirm whether this is keepalive related? I see a surge of new TCP connections per second on NLB.

maria: metrics: new_conn/s jumped from 200 -> 1800 on euc2b-nlb at ~18:22 UTC. target group healthy count dropped from 18 -> 12 around same time.

ops-oncall: initial hypothesis: backend pods are dropping connections on high new connection churn due to keepalive/idle timeout mismatch. mitigation options: 1) enable connection re-use by changing proxy settings, 2) increase NLB idle timeout, 3) shift traffic with route53 weighted policy to euc2a. Which to do first?

siva: quick mitigation: put euc2b target group into draining mode and shift 30% weight to euc2a to reduce pressure. I'll run route shift now.

siva: running AWS CLI command to update Route53 weight:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZZZ --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"edge.redwood.com.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"euc2a-primary","Weight":70,"TTL":60,"AliasTarget":{...}}}]}'
```

support-bot: noted affected customers: several API keys reporting retries and increased latency. Support queue 42 tickets referencing 502/504 to /v1/generate in euc2. Raising customer-impact alert to CSMs.

laura: while shifting, also increasing NLB idle timeout from 350 -> 1200s on the NLB to reduce spurious resets. applying now (may require connection re-establishment): `aws elbv2 modify-load-balancer-attributes --load-balancer-arn arn:lb:euc2b --attributes Key=idle_timeout.timeout_seconds,Value=1200`

samir: also toggled Envoy `use_remote_address` and bumped upstream keepalive to reduce connection churn on pods; restarting 3 pods in rotation.

maria: after route shift and adjustments, new_conn/s dropped to ~400 and 5xx rate fell to 1.4% within 3 minutes. target group healthy count returned to 17. Good recovery so far :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: monitoring for 30m. creating incident/pg ticket. assigning oncall handoff to @erin for follow-up and postmortem.

erin: taking handoff. will run replay of traffic profile in staging against same config and capture heap/network stats. I'll also open a changelog request to standardize NLB idle_timeout and envoy keepalive defaults across regions.

eng-lead-kevin: great work. please include metrics for new_conn/s, 5xx rate, target healthy count, and timeline in the postmortem. Notify any impacted enterprise customers via SRE->CS once we have final impact window.

siva: official incident timeline: 18:22 UTC spike detected -> 18:24 route shift + NLB idle_timeout change -> 18:27 partial recovery -> 18:30 steady recovery. I'll update runbook with step: test idle timeout alignment before scale events.

alert-bot: Incident marked 'mitigated' by ops-oncall at 2101112340 (18:30:40 UTC).

laura: postmortem owners: erin (lead), siva (ops), samir (runtime). tagging for follow-up: #postmortems channel. We'll aim for draft in 48h.

maria: closing thread, moving updates to postmortem doc once ready.
